las2_mapping_depth.formula: np.divide(fx*baseline_m, float32 disparity, out=float32 depth, where=finite positive disparity).
las2_mapping_depth.measurement_validity: Finite positive disparity; derived depth must remain finite and >=.30m. Zero/negative/NaN/Inf disparity, overflowed depth and subminimum depth remain NaN. No upper cutoff or endpoint clamp.
las2_mapping_depth.original_display_contract: metric_depth retains default .30..12.0m validity and original /stereo/valid mask; tests cover default and custom bounds.

publication.header: Both depth images use independent deep copies of the same rectified acquisition header, including exact sec/nanosec and calibrated camera frame after the existing image-time offset. Neither inference completion nor wall time replaces it.
publication.payload: Calibrated shape, 32FC1, float32 packed bytes, step=width*4, little-endian flag on the current little-endian platform. Both depths come from the same actual inferred disparity.

mapper.sanitize: Retain actual finite value >=min_range; rejected measurements become0. No far-value saturation/clipping.
mapper.filter: Same production four-neighbor edge rule abs(z-other) > .15+.05*min(z,other), applied after sanitize at pixel_stride2.
mapper.invalid_ray_guard: ValidDepthContinuousRay rejects out-of-bounds and nonfinite/nonpositive nearest sampled pixels before upstream computeUpdate. Active ContinuousRayConfig uses kNearestNeighbor, matching the guard.
mapper.range_model: Unchanged HashedChunkedWaveletIntegrator + native PinholeCameraProjector + ContinuousRay sigma.1/free.2/occupied.4, configured optical-Z update interval .3..8m.
mapper.wiring: Simulation/config/wavemap.yaml chooses /stereo/mapping_depth. configure_wavemap deep-copies and preserves depth_topic while freezing calibration. prepare_scene and run_pipeline load that resulting run yaml. Node default remains /stereo/depth, so use the configured pipeline for the separate mapping path.

upstream_range_contract.declaration: ProjectiveIntegratorConfig::max_range limits map updates; farther actual measurements are free-space beams. For cameras, evaluated range is optical Z, not radial distance.
upstream_range_contract.cell_evaluation: ProjectiveIntegrator::computeUpdate rejects evaluated centers outside min/max before delegating to the measurement model. ContinuousRay compares actual measured distance and preserves its surface uncertainty band (3sigma front,6sigma back).
upstream_range_contract.coarse_support_limit: RangeImageIntersector rejects AABBs entirely outside range. The chunked coarse-to-fine integrator may apply a center-sampled free update to an entire coarse node that straddles8m. Therefore max_range8m is not a voxel-exact spatial crop. No extra clip/crop or upstream algorithm change was introduced.
upstream_range_contract.observed_native_limit: Uniform12m synthetic case with configured max_range8m contains16,384 projected observed cell centers beyond8m, maximum9.55m; all occupied counts remain0 in that synthetic case.

reviewed_contracts: Uncapped actual finite far values including >12m
Original display metric depth and validity cap retained
Same scalar acquisition header, camera frame, shape and packing
Same source measurement model, edge thresholds and native update range
material_limits: Retained far neighbors expand the valid-neighbor set of the unchanged edge filter and can reject adjacent in-range pixels. A/B coverage/occupancy changes are not purely additive.
All-invalid synthetic proves no map update for that entire input; it is not a pixel-perfect spatial-support guarantee for mixed valid/invalid coarse voxels.
Low-disparity finite far predictions may be inaccurate; retention restores source measurement semantics, not ground-truth free-space certification.
Native coarse cells can extend across the nominal8m update boundary.
The captured-input A/B begins with empty maps and preserves acquisition throttling, but does not replay all historical live-map inputs, ROS queues or intermediate publication scheduling.
